description: Summary of South African Traffic Monitoring Data (1994-2006) is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Jesse Kalwij (Stellenbosch University). Mikros Traffic Monitoring (Pty) Ltd provides a traffic data collection service to various clients. Their biggest client is the South African National Roads Agency for which they operate in the order of 350 Permanent & another 450 Secondary Stations Countrywide on all National Roads. Coverage: South Africa. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is restricted according to the metadata; the conditions were not read. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
